description: This Kotlin source file defines the ProductDetailsFragment class, a UI component in an Android app responsible for displaying details of a specific product, handling user interactions such as adding to cart and toggling favorites, and observing changes to the favorite status.

classes.name: ProductDetailsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays product details, manages user interactions like adding products to the cart and toggling favorites, and updates UI based on favorite status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method that initializes the fragment and retrieves the product ID from arguments.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Lifecycle method that sets up UI components, binds product data, and sets event listeners for buttons.

methods.name: bindProduct
methods.description: Binds product properties to corresponding UI elements.

methods.name: updateFavoriteUi
methods.description: Updates the favorite button's UI state based on whether the product is marked as favorite.
